title: You Do Not Need Approval To Stay Steady
channelDescription: Ancient logic for the high-performance digital age

scenes.narrationSegment: Finance wants cost, Marketing wants speed. They disagree. You panic and think they hate you. They don't.
That friction isn't personal rejection. It's just role conflict.
Finance is paid to cut costs; Marketing is paid to grow. If you try to please both, you burn out trying to control the uncontrollable. The Stoic move? Stop apologizing.
Stop over-explaining. Your job is to do the right thing for your role, not to be everyone's friend. When you stop seeking validation, you gain respect.
Your leaders will say, 'We need more people like him,' even if you never asked for the spotlight. Calm isn't avoiding conflict. It's knowing the disagreement isn't about you. It's about the job.
Where do you feel this approval pressure most? Tell me below. Subscribe to @stoic-modernized for practical Stoic tools you can use at work.
